title: Quality Director (CONFIDENTIAL - DO NOT POST)
text:
The Quality Director will develop and drive a quality strategy across welding, electrical, and fabrication departments, expanding the plant with high-level thinking and quality system development.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and implement a comprehensive quality strategy for welding, electrical, and fabrication operations.
* Lead cross-functional teams across multiple shifts to ensure quality objectives are met.
* Engage with C-suite and customers to communicate quality performance and respond to inquiries.
* Manage ISO certification processes, recertifications, and external audits.
* Oversee continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality and operational efficiency.
* Build and maintain a responsive customer communication framework to address quality concerns.

### **Qualifications:**

* BS in Electrical, Mechanical, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering
* 10+ years of experience in Quality Management
* 10+ years of experience in a discrete manufacturing environment of electro-mechanical equipment
* Very responsive customer communication
* 8+ years of experience in high level customer engagement - C-suite communication
* Experience managing multi-disciplinary teams (welding, electricians, quality) across multiple shifts and operations
* Experience with ISO certifications, recerts, audits
* Experience in a welding/fabrication environment
* Experience in an electrical background

### **Preferred Skills:**

* Experience in UL
* Strong understanding of welding processes

### **Benefits:**

* Salary: $150-180K
* Annual bonus plan 15-25% on target bonus
